Title: Persona
Synopsis: A nurse is assigned to care for Elisabeth, an actress who has unaccountably stopped speaking and is seemingly unresponsive to anyone. The strange relationship between the two women begins to dissolve the boundaries between their identities and personalities as they spend time together.

Title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
Synopsis: A poetic meditation on human evolution, technology, artificial intelligence, and the possibility of extraterrestrial life as astronauts journey toward Jupiter.
Major_Awards: Academy Award Best Visual Effects; Cannes Special Screening; Ranked #1 greatest film of all time by Sight & Sound 2022

Title: The Swimmer
Synopsis: An advertising executive swims through a series of connected backyard pools in an attempt to journey home, only to discover darker truths about his suburban life.
Major_Awards: Roger Ebert 4 stars; 100% Rotten Tomatoes; Cult film status; Career-defining Burt Lancaster performance

Title: Harakiri
Synopsis: A ronin requests to commit seppuku at a feudal lord's manor and uses the opportunity to expose hypocrisy of the samurai code through a tale of revenge.
Major_Awards: Cannes Special Jury Award 1963; 100% Rotten Tomatoes; Roger Ebert Great Movie; One of greatest films of all time
